II A every legitimate operation that can be performed without work supply must fall within the scope of conditionally uniformity-covariant operations . Here, we assume that the converse is also true, namely that all such operations can be performed freely; so that the work cost defined under such oper - ations is equal to the actual work cost in its literal sense. Note that even in a less permissive setting without this assumption; the work cost defined under conditionally uniformity-covariant operations still provides a no-go limit on the actual work cost. Fourth; we accommodate the practical need for approximate conversion; where a bounded error is tolerated.
